naming.class_type: export class named exactly like the wx class in TsClassFileName(), e.g. wxFrame in wxFrame_gen.ts
naming.constant: export const NAME: number in kwx_constants_gen.ts
naming.constructor: module-level factory TsFactoryName(), e.g. createWxFrame(...) in wxFrame_gen.ts
naming.event_bind: Bind(first, last, type, closure) on the wrapper class
naming.method: PascalCase instance method on the wrapper class, e.g. frame.SetTitle(text)
naming.module: one ES module per class (wx<Class>_gen.ts) re-exported by kwx_gen.ts

events.handler_type: (closure: Pointer) => void  // native callback, wrapped with createWxClosure
